key_points: Amazon paused air cargo operations after a fatal crash, creating short‑term operational headwinds.
Anthropic reported second consecutive quarter of adjusted operating profit, boosting confidence in Amazon’s AI investment.
Wall Street pushed back on AI spending warnings, suggesting continued cloud demand for AWS.
Reports of a potential up‑to‑$60 bn Amazon‑Qualcomm deal signal expanding AI infrastructure procurement.
Large institutional purchases (e.g., Danske Bank >10 m shares) and strong India sales growth support underlying demand.
